verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents claiming additional sandboxes from a snapshot ID to run parallel tasks, which is its own concurrency capability. It also notes that resume depends on available capacity. Nothing in the evidence covers large-fleet scale or states any concurrency limits or quotas, and the route-level rate limits apply to services, not to sandbox concurrency. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas per team or region, evidence of large-scale fleet operation, independent or hands-on corroboration of concurrent throughput.
